question: What is the meaning of social life cycle assessment (slca) in relation to chemical properties?
description: Social Life Cycle Assessment (SLCA) in relation to chemical properties focuses on analyzing the social and sociological aspects of products along their life cycle, such as human rights, working conditions, governance, health, and safety. It does not specifically address chemical properties but rather emphasizes the social impacts and considerations associated with the production and use of products.
